title: Create .env.local.example with all required environment variables
description: Create a .env.local.example file documenting all required and optional environment variables. Ensure .env.local is in .gitignore. This prevents accidental secret commits and documents the setup for new developers.
acceptanceCriteria: `.env.local.example` exists at project root with all variables documented
All API keys have placeholder values and comments explaining how to obtain them
No actual secrets are committed to the repository

steps.details:
Create `.env.local.example` at project root with the following content:
```
# Anthropic API Key (required) — get at https://console.anthropic.com/
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your_anthropic_api_key_here

# Pexels API Key (required) — get at https://www.pexels.com/api/
PEXELS_API_KEY=your_pexels_api_key_here

# Resend API Key (optional — only needed for EMAIL_MODE=live) — get at https://resend.com/
RESEND_API_KEY=your_resend_api_key_here

# Email mode: 'mock' (default, never sends) or 'live' (sends via Resend)
EMAIL_MODE=mock

# From email address (used in live email mode)
EMAIL_FROM=noreply@yourdomain.com
```
Open `.gitignore` and confirm `.env.local` and `.env*.local` are listed. Also add `data/` and `exports/` and `uploads/` to .gitignore if not already present.

steps.description: Create src/lib/env.ts for server-side environment variable validation

technicalNotes: Never commit .env.local — it contains API keys.
The EMAIL_MODE=mock default is a safety mechanism. Developers must explicitly set EMAIL_MODE=live to send real emails.
Add a note in README.md instructing developers to copy .env.local.example to .env.local and fill in their keys.
